packMeta.name: OHS & QMS (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey ISO 45001 safety and ISO 9001 quality management system: incident & injury register, interactive 5x5 risk matrix hazard register, CAPA tracker, audits/CARs/NCRs with printable reports, mandatory training matrix, contractor approvals, toolbox talks, complaints and plant register. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 12 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
